answers.explanation: That's why the database can get faster without your code changing.
Documents look like your objects, so there's less of it.
One-to-many trees loaded as a unit are the document model's sweet spot.
Denormalized copies make reads simple and updates painful.
Like static vs. dynamic typing: neither is strictly better.
Questions that cut across documents need several queries or $lookup joins.
The flexibility moves the work into the reader.
